Oneliner

Demonstrate complex signal analysis with a Software-Defined Radio payload.
Description

Software Defined Radio payload. Wireless bus technology demonstration as a secondary payload. Demonstrate re-programmable software defined radio techniques on UHF. Potential applications include: data and image transmission, APRS reception, RFI mapping and as a general testbed for new amateur digital modes.

Bluetooth proof of concept for wireless intra-satellite communication between the subsystems.
